messages:
sam_support: FYI customer reported a ~3x drop in embeddings vectors/sec on /v2/embeddings since last deploy (around 2026-02-25 18:03 UTC). tokens/sec looks normal. :thinking:

nina_infra: Can you share the customer workload? batch sizes, input dims, model variant?

sam_support: They send batches of 8 docs, 1536-dim model (open-embed-v2), requests spike every 2s. We measured tokens/sec ~stable 120k/s but vectors/sec dropped from ~2.5k/s to ~800/s. No 5xxs, but queue depth is high.

cheng_ml: Interesting — tokens/sec stable but vectors/sec drop often means batching is breaking (more small batches) or a fallback to a higher-latency variant. Did routing/policy change in the deploy?

eli_devex: I pulled logs — deploy toggled "continuous_batching" -> false in serving config for the variant the customer hit. That would force immediate flushes and create a lot of small batches.

sam_support: omg that makes sense. Is there an easy hotfix?

nina_infra: We can re-enable continuous_batching for that variant, or route that customer to a sibling variant with the old config. Ops-bot, can you show recent policy changes? :eyes:

ops-bot: policy-audit: change detected by deploy 1769499800 -> changed field: continuous_batching=false for model open-embed-v2:variant-B. Link: https://ops.example/redeploy/1769499800

cheng_ml: Re-enabling batching should recover GPU throughput. When batching disabled, GPU utilization drops and tails increase because many tiny kernels run. Also check kv-cache behavior for embeddings (should be disabled) so not relevant here.

eli_devex: Patch ready — rolling config update to set continuous_batching=true for variant-B. Rolling now to 3 pods, will monitor.

sam_support: Meanwhile customer seeing increased queue depth: logs show queue_size spiking to ~220 while service_rate stayed ~600 vectors/sec. They asked for a hot workaround.

nina_infra: Hot workaround: route customer to dedicated "variant-A" which still has batching. Command: 
```bash
# create override route for customer org-id 1234
redwood-cli route create --org 1234 --model open-embed-v2:variant-A --priority 10
```

cheng_ml: Also try increasing max_batch_latency_ms to 60 on the variant if you need larger batching windows temporarily. That reduces request latency slightly but improves vectors/sec.

ops-bot: deploy-monitor: new config rollout started at 1769502100. 3/3 pods updated, health ok.

eli_devex: Early recovery metrics look promising — vectors/sec jumped from ~900 -> ~2400 in the affected cluster. GPU util up from 37% -> 89%.

sam_support: Customer confirmed improved throughput. They still saw occasional dimension-mismatch errors yesterday (downstream app assumed 1024 dims). That was a separate client-side bug; we asked them to confirm model variant and embedding_dim in their client.

nina_infra: Action items: (1) add deploy-time guard to prevent toggling continuous_batching off without service-owner signoff, (2) add synthetic throughput smoke test that simulates batched embeddings (measure vectors/sec), (3) notify SRE on config-rollouts that affect batching.

cheng_ml: I'll add the smoke test to our CI inference-sanity suite. Example repro (run from staging):
```python
# repro throughput for embeddings
import time, requests
start=time.time()
for i in range(200):
  payload=[{"text":"x"}] * 8
  r=requests.post(url, json={"input":payload})
  r.raise_for_status()
end=time.time(); print('vecs/s', 200*8/(end-start))
```

eli_devex: Marking this thread resolved for support after customer ack. Will follow up on the guard rails ticket. :white_check_mark:
